### God Opens the Heart
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/solid-joys/god-opens-the-heart
Passage: Acts 16:14
Points:
- People naturally reject the gospel because of spiritual deadness and hardness of heart.
- Scripture teaches that believers are appointed to eternal life and granted repentance by God.
- Lydia provides the clearest biblical example of conversion, showing that the Lord opens the heart to believe.
- Christians should spend their lives overflowing with amazed gratitude for the miracle of their faith.

### All in the Family
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-august-10-2023.html
Passage: Acts 16:14-15
Points:
- Lydia's encounter demonstrates that salvation occurs when the Lord opens the heart to respond in faith.
- Saving faith moves an individual from nominal religious interest into the family of God.
- Conversion inevitably prompts believers to embrace and serve fellow Christians despite differences.
- Believers are challenged to generously offer their homes, time, and resources to build up the church.
